title: Findings on shelf blueprints and on rcf-lite itself go to rcf-lite
asA: operator whose agent has logged a finding on a shelf blueprint or on rcf-lite core
iWant: those findings routed to Stravica/rcf-lite by default without any per-project configuration
soThat: reports about shelf content and core verbs reach the maintainers who own them

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pending entry with kind blueprint and a target that resolves in the manifest without a libraryPrefix (a shelf blueprint) has destination.repo Stravica/rcf-lite on preview and submit. The constant is sourced from packages/rcf-lite/package.json:bugs.url so a rename ripples through one file. A test pins the constant to the current package.json value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project applying application-forms-wizard (shelf blueprint) with one pending entry
acceptanceCriteria.then: the rendered destination row is "Stravica/rcf-lite (public)"; a unit test asserts the constant equals bugs.url from package.json

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pending entry with kind core (target is a verb path like "define validate" or "docs") has destination.repo Stravica/rcf-lite regardless of any library manifest content; the entry cannot be routed to a library repo even if a library declares the verb name as a target.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with a library declaring "define validate" as a target and one pending core entry
acceptanceCriteria.then: the destination.repo is Stravica/rcf-lite for the core entry; the library declaration is ignored for kind core; a warning is not emitted (this is by design)
